items.summary: Create an admin dashboard landing page that displays navigation cards for managing courses, videos, notes, tests, current affairs, branding (logo/colors), and viewing registered students. Include statistics overview showing total counts for each content type.

Enhance the existing ManageCourses admin page to support editing and deleting courses in addition to adding new courses. Display a list of all existing courses with edit and delete buttons for each course.

Create a video management admin page where admins can add YouTube video links with metadata (title, category, description), edit existing videos, and delete videos. Display all videos in a searchable and filterable list.

Enhance the existing ManageTests admin page to support editing and deleting test series. Display a list of all existing tests with edit and delete buttons, and allow admins to modify questions within a test.
Enhance the existing ManageNotes admin page to support editing and deleting notes. Display a list of all uploaded notes with subject, title, and action buttons for each note.

Enhance the existing ManageCurrentAffairs admin page to support editing and deleting current affairs entries. Display a list of all current affairs posts with type (daily/weekly/monthly), date, and action buttons.
Create a branding settings admin page where admins can upload a new logo image, preview it, and update the logo used throughout the platform. Store the logo as a generated image asset.
Create a student management admin page that displays a searchable and filterable table of all registered students showing name, email, registration date, and activity status.

Update backend main.mo to add CRUD endpoints for updateCourse, deleteCourse, updateTest, deleteTest, updateNote, deleteNote, updateCurrentAffair, deleteCurrentAffair, updateLogo, and getAllStudents with proper admin authorization checks.

Update the Navigation component to dynamically load and display the logo from backend configuration instead of using a hardcoded path, allowing logo changes from the branding settings page to reflect immediately.
